## Acquisition gate

An item may move from `planned` to `acquired` only after the source artifact has been obtained and its provenance recorded. Source verification alone does not imply that observations have been acquired.
Required provenance for each imported observation:
- source_id
- source title
- official URL or stable document identifier
- retrieval date
- reporting period
- source-defined variable name
- source definition
- original value
- transformation status.
For group-specific organization data, acquisition additionally requires evidence that the reported group dimension and flow concept correspond to the observation stored in the analysis schema.
